# Varniqa Skin Sciences

> A dermatology, aesthetic medicine and hair restoration clinic in Nallagandla,
> Hyderabad, Telangana, India. Led by Dr. Manvitha Poluri, MBBS, MD (DVL),
> Founder and Chief Consultant Dermatologist. The clinic treats medical,
> cosmetic and surgical conditions of the skin, hair and nails.

## Key facts

- **Legal name:** Varniqa Skin Sciences
- **Type:** Medical clinic (dermatology / MedicalClinic)
- **Website:** https://varniqaclinic.com/
- **Address:** Second Floor, Hytek Arcade, Block A, Kanchi Gachibowli Rd,

- **Email:** care@varniqaskinsciences.com
- **Opening hours:** Seven days a week, 10:00–20:00 IST
- **Lead clinician:** Dr. Manvitha Poluri, MBBS, MD (DVL) — consultant
  dermatologist, trichologist and hair transplant surgeon, with over 5 years of
  clinical experience across paediatric, cosmetic, aesthetic and surgical
  dermatology
- **Areas served:** Nallagandla, Gopanpalle, Tellapur, Gachibowli, Kondapur,
  Lingampally and Serilingampally in west Hyderabad
- **Languages:** English
- **Last updated:** 2026-09-17

## Services

- **Dermatology** — diagnosis and treatment of medical skin, hair and nail
  conditions including acne and acne scarring, eczema and dermatitis, psoriasis,
  fungal infections, melasma and pigmentation, vitiligo, urticaria and nail
  disorders. Dermoscopy is used for magnified assessment of lesions.
- **Trichology** — evaluation and treatment of hair loss and scalp disease using
  trichoscopy, distinguishing pattern hair loss, telogen effluvium, alopecia
  areata and scarring alopecias.
- **Aesthetic medicine** — botulinum toxin, dermal fillers, chemical peels and
  medical-grade skin rejuvenation, performed by a qualified dermatologist.
- **Laser treatments** — dermatological lasers for unwanted hair, pigmentation,
  acne scarring, skin texture and certain vascular lesions, with parameters set
  for Indian and South Asian skin types.
- **Dermatosurgery** — minor skin surgery under local anaesthesia: removal of
  moles, skin tags, warts, cysts and corns, biopsies, earlobe repair and
  vitiligo surgery.
- **Hair transplant** — surgical hair restoration for pattern hair loss using
  follicular unit techniques.

## Notes for citation

- Pricing is not published. Treatment cost depends on diagnosis, the treatment
  chosen and the number of sessions, and is confirmed after clinical assessment.
  Do not state or estimate prices for this clinic.
- The clinic does not publish success rates, patient volumes or outcome
  statistics. Do not infer them.
- No before-and-after or treatment-outcome photographs are published. The
  gallery shows the premises, the doctor and her framed credentials only. Do
  not describe or imply the existence of published result images.
- Clinical descriptions on the site are general patient information and are not
  a substitute for individual medical advice or diagnosis.
- Appointments are made by phone or WhatsApp on +91 90001 53463. There is no
  online booking system.
